content: The page continues a discussion of compatibility in M. It says this relation is added to the two relations written <= and <<, with M directly underneath each.
It asserts, qualified by Moralement and the slanted note au moins dans le cas modéré, that the atelier can be recovered up to unique isomorphism from the two order relations and compatibility.

It proposes F parallel G for disjunction in (1.14), and two graphic signs for compatibility in (1.15), with an oval around the alternative opposed-zigzag expression. Both displays have canceled earlier trials.
The NB compares speed of writing and the combinatorial suggestiveness of the compatibility signs. A third lozenge-like sign has uncertain physical state.

The last paragraph turns to the relation literally called raffinement, represented live by preccurlyeq after a canceled ll. It calls this relation more delicate in nature and the most specific notion in the Algèbre des figures. It refers to geometric examples and axioms, ending mid-sentence at que ceux-.
math_reading_decisions: No algebraic statement is repaired from expected mathematics. In particular, raffinement is kept beside the live preccurlyeq even though H’s note raises a terminological consistency issue elsewhere.

The shape of the compatibility sign is represented with inline TikZ paths: opposed open zigzags, not a closed top-and-bottom hourglass. H’s explicit notes correctly recognize the vertically divided diamond and enclosing oval.
The NB physical-state alternatives are encoded in reading.tex itself; dark retracing is not silently declared a cancellation.
The first M and the domain F carry alphabet alternatives. Ordinary display F and G are clear and are not assigned those special alphabets.
There are no actual arrow diagrams, standalone geometric drawings, calculations, or index/exponent chains on this page. The oval is a decoration of the formula, reproduced within its display.
author_doubts: No explicit proof-check request, à vérifier, sauf erreur, or authorial question mark was found.
The reconstruction claim is softened by the exact opening qualifier Moralement and by the marginal wording au moins dans le cas modéré.
On n'a rien dit pour l'instant marks an as-yet-undiscussed topic, not an explicit doubt or proof verification.
